Definition
[Sweep-out] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0240 1. ch33:33.10\group CMC and harmonic parametrizations

A family of hypersurfaces $\{ S_s\} _{s\in I}$ sweeps out a region $U$ when $U\subset \bigcup _{s\in I}S_s$.
